question.content: alright, let's bake some cookies. you've got 7 chocolate chip cookies ready to go. then emma sneaks in and puts 5 more on the baking tray (cheeky emma!). how many cookies are there altogether ready for the oven? [[☃ numeric-input 1]]

hints.content: remember, addition is just putting things together. like buddy's toys all in one pile.
you're really good at spotting patterns. can you see a pattern in the numbers to help you add them?
count on from 7. so 8, 9, 10... keep going until you've added 5. (no rush, we'll wait)
